protocol.selection: One variant per family, shared across all three assets. Rank only on the six development cells (three assets x two halves). Score = median return percentage - 0.25 * worst drawdown percentage. Require at least 5 trades per cell and 60 total. Require score above original preset. Freeze selection before computing validation/final results. Ties resolve by variant ID.
protocol.researchAdoption: Adopt the frozen variant for simulation only when at least two of three assets improve in validation and mean validation return improves. Otherwise retain original. Final results do not select parameters or adoption.
protocol.trendFilter: Close > EMA200, EMA50 > EMA200, EMA200 above its value 24 candles ago.
protocol.costFilter: Stop distance >= 3 times estimated roundtrip cost (fees + slippage). Decision uses only closed signal candle ATR and close. Base threshold 0.72% of price.
protocol.claim: Exploratory recalibration using history already examined in prior work. Later windows are excluded from parameter ranking but are not virgin out-of-sample evidence. No strategy is approved automatically. No second search after these results.
